releases.title: Fix Windows media progress and tablet resync, pin patched Node

items.text: The log records when a tablet's catch-up fails and when a tablet disconnects.
The Windows now-playing position no longer counts up for players that report no timeline, and keeps moving while a track plays.
A tablet that reconnects after a change gets an update that applies cleanly to the config it already has.

releases.title: Add coding-agent deck editing, deck files, and SDK conditions

items.text: Add Coding agents in Setup to create and revoke tokens for AI coding tools.
Serve an MCP endpoint on this computer so coding agents can edit the deck and automations.
Ask before an agent adds a program launch, and refuse launches driven by variables or sliders.
Export the deck to a file and import it with Replace or Append.
Preview a deck file's pages and warnings before importing it.
Install icon packs from plugin repositories in the Plugins panel.
Add a site footer to public pages.
Let plugins light keys with a condition (active.when) instead of only a value.
Hide internal settings, add per-setting help, and link a plugin guide.
Keep rapid config edits in order so quick changes do not conflict.
Keep the changelog version label readable on long version numbers.
Publish llms.txt and per-page search metadata for public pages.

releases.title: Keep key presses fast while a plugin is busy, choose how much gets logged, and help search engines find the site

items.text: The icon picker lists icon packs from your plugin repositories and installs them in a click.
Download repository icon packs with a checksum and size check, and never install the same pack twice.
Flexdeck-plugin repo --icon-packs lists icon pack zips in repository.json beside the plugins.
The Rust plugin ABI reads the iconPacks list in a repository index.
Choose how much FlexDeck logs in Settings, from errors only to every plugin call; Info is the default.
The log notes when a key waited for a plugin and when a plugin was slow to answer.
The title bar shows which version of FlexDeck you're running.
Each public page has its own title, description and link preview, and the site publishes a sitemap so search engines can find every page.
A key press only waits for the plugin it uses, so one slow plugin no longer delays every key by seconds.
A flow with waits in it no longer holds up other keys while it waits.
Reinstalling or reloading a plugin while a flow is waiting no longer makes the flow's next step fail.
Saving a plugin's settings, or removing or reloading a plugin, no longer pauses your keys while that plugin is busy.
A mistyped address shows a not-found page instead of the home page.

releases.title: Keep keys responsive when a plugin is slow, keep a log, and tidy the key editor

items.text: FlexDeck keeps a log of the last 7 days in its data folder, so you have something to send when something goes wrong.
Icons in a pack are grouped by category, and search matches category names.
Pick a key's icon, and each look's icon, from a sheet instead of typing its name.
A look's label can include values, like any other key text.
A look's "While" box suggests value names as you type, but not inside quoted text.
Icon packs can give each icon a category.
The editor loads each piece of data once and refreshes it only when the desktop says it changed.
A slow or stuck plugin no longer holds up key presses or the other plugins' values.
A burst of value changes updates your keys once instead of once per change.
If installing a plugin fails, the consent sheet tells you why instead of closing without a word.
A remote editor you closed stops counting as watching, even if it never said goodbye.
Saving through the cloud relay gets up to two minutes before it times out, and a desktop that doesn't answer in time shows as a timeout, not a broken connection.
If a plugin action fails, the plugins panel shows the error.
Key borders follow rounded corners in the preview.
Text alignment says Left, Centre and Right, and the text style controls have room to breathe.

releases.title: Swipe pages from on top of keys without pressing them

items.text: On decks with more than one page, a swipe that starts on a key, zone or slider's mute row turns the page instead of pressing it.
A quick tap or a shaky press still counts as a press, never a page swipe.

releases.title: Light toggle keys, pick looks by gesture or value, and flag keys a plugin update broke

items.text: Keys that toggle something light up while it's on, and a light you clear stays cleared.
A key's look can follow its last gesture — tap, long press, or hold until you let go.
Show a different look while a value holds, like "Recording" while OBS records.
Hide a key's corner dot without turning off its light.
Variable names complete one level at a time as you type.
Keys can hide their corner dot.
The media play key lights while something is playing.
An action can light its key while a true/false value is on, or while it holds a fixed value, and the value's name can include the action's arguments.
A key's light can follow another plugin's value.
A key whose plugin no longer has its action, or now needs an argument the key doesn't give, shows a warning and ignores presses until the plugin has it again.
Draw keys a plugin update broke shaded with a warning, and don't send their presses.
Keys that ran a data source of their own now read the shared one, moved once on first start and undoable in the editor.
A deck the agent refuses is reported as the sender's mistake, not a server error.

releases.title: Retry taken ports, reuse one window, and gate command sources

items.text: Reuse the open window when flexdeck is launched again.
Cla workflow.
Retry a taken port every 5s and as soon as the window is focused.
Move the default agent port to 23539 and same-PC door to 23540.
Default to port 23539 to match the desktop agent.
Reach the same-PC agent on port 23540.
Require a yes at the desktop for command sources from elsewhere.
Keep a key's address from borrowing another key's shared token.
Flag imported sources that send requests to another host.

releases.title: Publish the plugin SDKs and move official plugins to their own repo

items.text: Publish @flexdeck/plugin-sdk and create-flexdeck-plugin on npm, flexdeck-plugin-abi and flexdeck-plugin-sdk on crates.io, and flexdeck on PyPI.
A "Minimize to tray" setting that hides the minimized window from the taskbar.
Load the official and vetted plugin lists from Questory-Labs/FlexDeck-Plugins.

releases.title: Allocate widget ids across the whole configuration

items.text: Derive next widget id from every profile and page.

releases.title: Replace re-paired devices and ship window prefs with side-by-side dev

items.text: Add optional client_id so re-pair replaces the old device row.
Persist device.client and revoke-all with keep-self.
Add forget-me and revoke-all; mark kind and current on devices.
Forward clientId on browser pair; serve api-only portal stub.
Send install clientId, forget-me on disconnect, .dev package.
Window prefs for autostart, start minimized, and close to tray.
Paginate devices with remove-all and kind pills.
JsonTree raw config, paged devices, revoke-all others.
Add Pager, Pill, paginate, and useSteadyHeight.
Proxy /api WebSockets and harden unreachable/cut-off errors.

releases.title: Ship scoped releases with Linux packages and per-ABI Android APKs

items.text: Add platforms to the Release type used by downloads.
Keep the full pre-release version in the Tauri config.

releases.title: Test release candidate
releases.blurb: A first test build of the desktop and Android apps.

items.text: Add configurator live feed at /api/live with cloud watch leases.
Relay live frames through /api/live after desktop watch grants.
Consume live socket for revision, state, page, devices, sources.
Ship FillPicker with linear/radial gradients and angle dial.
Add ColorArea, HueStrip, AngleDial, Popover, and Endpoint.
Raise ABI 4 with action.active for lit keys while a pick holds.
OBS Studio: bump to 0.4 with scene/record/stream presets and set_scene active.
Add connection panel, ASCII link view, and pairing polish.
Surface endpoint address/port on home and pair screens.
Add download, docs, and changelog routes with site nav.
Split public site vs editor-only builds via VITE flags.
Run pnpm dev/build from app cwd in Tauri hooks.
